summary.text: Wayne Parry is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 140 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Parry has represented District 140 since 2022 and earlier represented District 10, and Ballotpedia lists him as a lobsterman and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Parry lives in Arundel, Maine, and graduated from Windham High School.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as owning a business and working as a lobsterman.
Parry represented Maine House District 10 from 2010 to 2018 and returned to that seat in 2020 after defeating incumbent Henry Ingwersen in the general election.
He was elected to District 140 in 2022 and won re-election in 2024, defeating Jason Nedeau.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Transportation Committee, where he was ranking member.
In 2026 he is on the general election ballot against Kirstan Watson, the Democratic candidate.
